meta.title: Buka Workflows
meta.description: Orchestrator-preset workflows in format 3: the shipped workflow-orchestrator preset turns a one-off request into a node graph of robot and user nodes and runs it, keeping one session per robot for the whole run. A user node pauses the graph for a decision, a manual action only a person can do, or feedback on a result only a human can see; every robot node declares a JSON Schema result and routes the run with next or abort. A read-only sidebar page shows each run as a layered graph with per-execution details, attachments and observations.
